segmentation.text: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer
When proper signs have been erected,

shall stop or yield at a clearly marked stop line or, if there is none, before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection or, if there is none, then at the point nearest the intersection where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the through highway.
After having stopped or, in the event of a yield sign, slowed or stopped,
to other vehicles which have entered the intersection from such through highway
or which are approaching so closely on such through highway as to constitute an immediate hazard
during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

elements.justification: 'Traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic ('pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances ... using any highway'), of which the subject is a member. 'Being controlled by a police officer' (DEF-NRS-484A-180 'every officer authorized to direct or regulate traffic') is dev.human_direction, 'a person directing traffic ... role ∈ {police_officer, ...}', of role police_officer governing (dev.governs) the subject's carrier c or X (st.travel_region), read at the subject's entry.

'Being controlled by ... a traffic-control signal' (DEF-NRS-484A-290 'by which traffic is alternately directed to stop or proceed'): a dev.traffic_signal governing c or X (dev.governs) that is not dev.inoperative ('installed and uncovered but showing no valid indication'): a dark signal directs nothing.

'Proper signs' are a dev.stop_sign ('regulatory sign requiring a full halt') or dev.yield_sign ('regulatory sign requiring yielding without a mandatory halt') governing (dev.governs) the carrier c the subject occupies (rel.occupies) whose entrance end is X (st.lane_enters), or X itself. Governance, not the sign's position, ties it to the approach.
Same mapping as 'The driver of a vehicle' in the index: the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'driver' is the vehicle's controlled motion.

'Stop' is DEF-NRS-484A-255, 'complete cessation from movement' (the definition whose scope is a stop 'when required'; DEF-NRS-484A-260 applies when stopping is prohibited), carried by drv.motion.complete_halt; at a stop sign it is owed. 'Yield' at a yield sign is, in the words of the next sentence, 'slowed or stopped': the subject's kin.speed ('magnitude of velocity') within the place's stopping zone is at or below the speed from which it still halts at the place (p.yield_line_speed_max), a halt included. The place, in the words' order: st.stop_line ('the transverse line marking where vehicles halt for a device') tied to c by st.entrance_of, its side along c's designated direction (st.lane_direction) given by prim.region_offset_along, the body-to-line distance by st.region_geometry; else st.crosswalk marking c's entrance, 'before entering' being a footprint not overlapping it (rel.occupies); else c's entrance end into X (st.intersection), the footprint outside X. Distance never stands for the association. 'Traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic; the view of its approaching members is a perception read through the place the words describe.

applicability: At the subject's entry into an intersection X: the observation at which its footprint overlaps X and did not at the previous observation, where at that previous observation it occupied a carrier c with st.lane_enters(c, X); where at the entry observation a stop sign or a yield sign governs c or X (dev.governs); except where at that observation a police officer's direction (dev.human_direction of role police_officer) governs c or X, or a traffic signal that is not inoperative (dev.inoperative false) governs c or X.
obligation: Search for the act on the approach: where a stop sign governs c or X, a complete halt (drv.motion.complete_halt, speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance); where only a yield sign does, an observation at which the subject's kin.speed is at or below p.yield_line_speed_max (a halt included) — in either case while occupying c within the stopping zone of the place for c, in the words' order: (1) where a stop line marks c's entrance (st.entrance_of(line, c)), the line ahead of or at the subject's reference point along c's designated direction (prim.region_offset_along at or above zero) and the body within p.stop_point_tolerance of the line (st.region_geometry distance); (2) where no stop line marks c (every line's entrance list observed and excluding c), the footprint not overlapping the crosswalk marking c's entrance, that crosswalk ahead along c's direction and the body within p.stop_point_tolerance of it; (3) where neither marks c, the footprint not overlapping X and the body within p.stop_point_tolerance of X. History bound: the search runs back from the entry and ends at the approach start — the last observation before the entry at which the subject, on a carrier the place marks, is outside the place's stopping zone upstream (off the mark, short of it along c's direction and farther from it than p.stop_point_tolerance; where several marks of that kind mark c, outside and short of each) — or at the subject's previous entry into X, whichever is later. Act found: compliant; either end reached without it: violated; neither end reached (the recording begins inside the zone): unknown. Each entry owes its own act; only an observed exit from the zone upstream begins a new approach. The entry is unknown where the previous observation does not show the subject on a mapped carrier; where a mark's association with c is unobserved and the verdict turns on it, unknown. No bound is taken from the recording's start, a first observation or a cumulative distance.

narrowings.why: 'proper signs have been erected' is a legal status; a stop or yield sign present and governing the approach is its evidence.
'clearly marked' is read as the stop line the scene represents; the paint's clarity is not modelled.

'the point nearest the intersection where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the through highway' is read as c's entrance end into X, the point nearest the intersection outside it: the view is a perception read through the place the words describe; no sight distance is measured.
'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls it.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A dev.stop_sign governs carrier c entering X; a st.stop_line marks c; no officer or operating signal. The subject passes the line and enters X with kin.speed well above p.halt_speed_tolerance, never halting since it was upstream of the line's stopping zone.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same scene; the subject halts on c with the line just ahead within p.stop_point_tolerance, then enters X.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No stop or yield sign governs c or X; the subject enters X without halting.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Stop sign governing c; kin.speed is absent, so whether the subject halted within the line's stopping zone is unknown.

scenarios.name: history_boundary
scenarios.narrative: Stop sign governing c; the recording begins with the subject already within p.stop_point_tolerance of the stop line, moving slowly; no halt is recorded before its entry into X.
scenarios.boundary: the approach start: the subject's last observation outside the stop line's stopping zone upstream on c lies before the recording

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: Only a dev.yield_sign governs c; the subject passes the stop line's zone at kin.speed at or below p.yield_line_speed_max and enters X.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: Only a yield sign governs c; the subject passes through the place's stopping zone with kin.speed well above p.yield_line_speed_max at every observation and enters X.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: A stop sign governs c, but a dev.human_direction of role police_officer governs c at the subject's entry; it enters X without halting.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's kinematic channels

param_proposals.name: p.stop_point_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the body-to-mark gap within which a halt counts as at the mark: a stop line's set-back before a crossing plus a placement margin
param_proposals.source: MUTCD stop line placement in advance of a crosswalk

param_proposals.name: p.yield_line_speed_max
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a vehicle at the place of a yield sign counts as having slowed: the speed from which a passenger car can still halt within the stop-point tolerance at a comfortable deceleration of about 4.5 m/s^2
param_proposals.source: AASHTO comfortable deceleration rate of the stopping sight distance model
